'''Krishels''' were strong, burrowing [[Limb/Legends|quadrupeds]] with hard shells that were found on the [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]]<ref name="SM" /> [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]]. The [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Mustafarian/Legends|Mustafarians]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to Mustafar [[Hunting/Legends|hunted]] krishels, tracking them through labyrinths of seemingly endless subterranean tunnels and [[Cave/Legends|caverns]].<ref name="SM" />

==Behind the scenes==
Krishels were mentioned in the [[2016]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying]]'' supplement ''[[Special Modifications]]'', which was published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]].<ref name="SM" />
